items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying all the axioms the cohomology of the base change of a smooth projective scheme along a finite separable algebra is the tensor product of the cohomology with the degree zero part of the spectrum of that algebra over the degree zero part of the base (statement lines 3752-3758). The proof (proof lines 3759-3784) decomposes the tensor product of the separable algebras and compares the two cohomologies through additivity and the product formula. H2: a complete short computation.
